summary: Reclaim transition. Dead shader: reclaim progress creeps green, nest red haze at the limb fades with progress, a wave front reveals the living (lush) map. planet_sphere.gd: set_reclaim, set_reclaim_flip, become_living, 'reclaimed' look (lush textures, clouds, palette). map.gd: _update_reclaim_looks drives creep, flip (game time) and first lights; a reclaimed world met on load snaps to living.
notes: No saved fields added (look derives from prosperity), so no save bump. No story text. Edge outside touches: planet_fx.gd is inside game/fx/planet, data/balance.json holds the keys. Screenshot logs/screenshots/T297.png shows the map renders.
